description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/time/zone (base $0.002; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?tz=America/New_York (optional to=Europe/Paris and at=2026-11-15T14:00:00Z). Time zone lookup for one IANA zone (e.g. America/New_York): local date and time, UTC offset, abbreviation, whether daylight saving is in effect and the next offset change, for now or a given instant; add to= to convert the same instant into a second zone. Computed from the IANA tz database (public domain); not an official time signal. Bad input: not charged. USDC on Base only.
